category: document parsing API, monthly free credits

free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0 a month: 10,000 credits a month, recurring (credits reset at the start of the next billing cycle). Parse costs 1 credit a page on the Fast tier, 3 on Cost-effective, 10 on Agentic and 45 on Agentic Plus; 1,000 credits are USD 1.25 on a paid plan. When the credits run out, a credit-consuming request on the Free plan returns HTTP 402
free_tier.notes: the credit is consumed per page for Parse (per minute for audio, per sheet for spreadsheets); the vocabulary has no page term. All products (Parse, Extract, Classify, Split, Index) draw on the same 10,000 credits

per_object_cap.stated: Parse: 512 MB per file and 10,000 pages per job after page selection; Extract: 100 MB per file and 500 pages per job

retention.stated: parsed files are cached for 48 hours; retained (non-expiring) files stay until deleted, up to 10,000 files / 10 GB per project on the Free plan

interface_detail: REST API (POST /api/v2/parse) plus Python, TypeScript, Go and Java SDKs, a CLI and a web UI
tooling: the llama_cloud Python SDK and the TypeScript, Go and Java SDKs, the CLI, or plain REST with an API key generated in the LlamaCloud console
chaining: a recurring monthly credit with no card; the Fast tier at 1 credit a page is the cheapest way to spend it, and the paid Starter plan adds credits when the Free plan runs out

limits.value: 10,000 credits a month on the Free plan (Parse: 1 credit a page Fast, 3 Cost-effective, 10 Agentic, 45 Agentic Plus); an exhausted Free plan returns HTTP 402 until the next billing cycle
Parse 512 MB per file and 10,000 pages per job; Extract 100 MB per file and 500 pages per job; 130+ document, image, spreadsheet and audio formats
parse job creation 500 requests per 10 seconds per organization, the same on every plan; 5 concurrent parse jobs on the Free plan

identity_cost.detail: a LlamaCloud account made at login.llamaindex.ai ('sign in with your preferred method'); the Free plan asks for no payment details, which are entered only when upgrading to a paid plan; unverified: the sign-up form's fields (email, social login or phone) were not visible in the captured sign-in page

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded; no request was made because a key needs a signed-in account
confidence_note: the Free plan's credit amount, its monthly reset, the HTTP 402 behaviour, the per-page credit cost, the file and page limits and the rate limit are quoted from vendor pages read on 2026-11-03. The sign-up form's fields are unverified, and no request was made.
